priorRequiredFinding.delta: Compared with subject-01, check_package_edges.py changes only line 40: the section list adds ('build_dependencies','build') and ('dev_dependencies','dev'). The loop already covers top-level and [target.*] tables. The tool file is byte-identical to the reviewer fix copy from review-01. The tests add two groups: synthetic stale checks for the four legacy tables, and a real Cargo edition-2021 metadata-before -> manifest-after -> fresh-metadata control. UNIT.md adds a description paragraph and changes twelve to fourteen; no new scope or qualification claim.

advisories.title: Conservative reading of legacy tables Cargo ignores
advisories.detail: Real Cargo 1.95 checks: when both hyphen and underscore tables are present (edition 2021, top-level or target), Cargo uses only the hyphen table and silently ignores the underscore one. Edition 2024 rejects underscore tables outright. The tool reads both, so a forbidden entry only in an ignored underscore table is refused, and differing allowed entries across the pair give 'declarations differ' with fresh or stale metadata. Identical duplicate entries pass. This fails closed and is acceptable, but the refusal can be spurious; optionally refuse underscore/hyphen coexistence and non-2024 editions with a clearer message.

advisories.title: Legacy kind mapping is not pinned by subject tests
advisories.detail: Mutating ('build_dependencies','build') to 'dev' survives the 14 tests; reviewer real-Cargo probes detect it (allowed legacy build edge becomes a false refusal). The failure is closed, not a bypass. A positive allowed-legacy-table test would pin it.

advisories.title: Carried from review-01: 13 of 31 mutants survive
advisories.detail: The 12 carried survivors are unchanged from subject-01 (build-dependencies hyphen table ignored in the manifest scan, optional flag on either side, workspace_root, duplicate local owner, manifest pathless and owner-path checks, manifest name, local missing from resolve, inventory escape, empty workspace, default members); the 13th is ADV-B's kind mapping. The hyphen build-dependencies survivor still removes part of the stale guarantee undetected by the subject tests, although reviewer probes detect it. All four new legacy mutants that drop or narrow coverage are killed.

advisories.title: Carried: stale guarantee is declaration-only
advisories.detail: A stale [lib] path escape and a stale addition of providers/rust to the host workspace still pass; fresh metadata refuses both. UNIT.md wording should stay limited to dependency declarations.
